name: gates
description: Four stateless PreToolUse gates plus a docs-consolidation trigger. Denies a git commit that changes code without staging its covering docs (per-plugin README/CLAUDE.md pairs, or the nearest README/CLAUDE/AGENTS walking up); asks before a new-project scaffold command (npm create vite, cargo new, rails new, …) runs ahead of an approved design; denies a high-fan-out Workflow script with no per-agent model: override and asks before a denylisted built-in named workflow; denies an ad-hoc Agent dispatch that omits model unless the agent type pins one in frontmatter. Separately, a never-blocking trigger counts commits since the .docs-sync record and nudges toward /docs-consolidate. Every gate has an ack marker.
